token.title: 🔑 Ithokheni ye-GitHub
token.intro: I-GitHub iphendula izicelo ezingama-60 ngeyure kwidilesi engathumeli thokheni. Umthi opheleleyo weefoki ubiza malunga nama-32, ngoko utyelelo lwesibini luyaphelelwa. Ithokheni iphakamisa umda ukuya kuma-5000 ngeyure.
token.step1: Vula Settings, Developer settings, Personal access tokens, Fine-grained tokens, emva koko Generate new token.
token.step2: Resource owner: iakhawunti yakho. Expiration: nawuphi na umhla, umthi awudingi nto ihlala ixesha elide.
token.step4: Musa ukuchukumisa nayiphi na imvume. Imetadatha kavimba kawonke-wonke ayifuni nanye kuzo.
token.step5: Yenza, emva koko ukhuphele ixabiso le-{token}. I-GitHub ilibonisa kube kanye kuphela.
token.classic: Ithokheni yakudala nayo iyasebenza: yenza enye ngaphandle kokuphawula nawuphi na umda. Umda ongenanto usafunda idatha kawonke-wonke ngesantya esiqinisekisiweyo.
token.stays: Ihlala kwesi sikhangeli phantsi kwesitshixo {key} kwaye ihamba kuphela iye ku-{host}. Ayibhalwa kwibha yedilesi, ngoko ikhonkco owabelana ngalo liphatha imbono hayi isiqinisekiso. Iqhosha elingaphantsi kwebala liyicima kwakhona kunye nogcino lwethutyana.
token.persistHow: Faka ithokheni kwifayile {env} yeseva ebamba eli phepha, ecaleni kwe-{port}:
token.proxy: uze uyiqalise nge-{make}. Isikhongozeli ke sibhala isiqwenga se-nginx esincamathisela iheda {header} kwiproksi {path}, ngoko isikhangeli sibiza imvelaphi yaso kwaye asiyifumani ithokheni. Eli bala liyanyamalala kwaye bonke abatyeleli babelana ngohlahlo-lwabiwo-mali olunye lwama-5000 ngeyure.
fork.refused404: Akukho migca yamasebe: {message}. I-404 apha lisebe elingekhoyo okanye yindlela engathwalwa yiproksi yeseva; uthungelwano lweefoki olungentla lupheleleyo nangayiphi na indlela.
fork.refusedExhausted: I-GitHub iphelelwe zizicelo kule yure, ngoko akukho migca yamasebe inokuzotywa. Uthungelwano lweefoki olungentla lupheleleyo. Yongeza ithokheni kwiphaneli yesihluzi, okanye ucime imigca yamasebe kwiphaneli yoyilo ukuze usebenzise uhlahlo-lwabiwo-mali kuthungelwano kuphela.
fork.refusedOther: I-GitHub iphendule {status} kwiimbali zeekhomithi, ngoko akukho migca yamasebe inokuzotywa. Uthungelwano lweefoki olungentla lupheleleyo.
fork.tagsOrphaned: Ithegi ayinamhla, ngoko ezinye ngazinye bezinokubiza isicelo esingachithwa sisabelo seyure esishiyekileyo.
fork.axisZoomed: {axis}, ifestile yeekhomithi neethegi ezilayishiweyo. Imigca yeefoki emidala kunayo ibanjwe kumda wasekhohlo.
fork.axisWhole: {axis}. Vula uvimba ukuze uzobe imizila yeekhomithi zawo nokudityaniswa kwazo; umgca ke uyacutheka ukuya kuloo mbali.

bond.help: Umqolo ukuya kwikholamu ngentla, ikholamu ukuya kumqolo ngezantsi. Iqhina elingu-0 liphepha, u-1 ngowona uchasene nalo. Ukuhambisa isalathisi kunqumla isibini ngombala omthubi, ukucofa kusitshixa ngomfusa kude kube kukucofa okulandelayo. Ukufunda kuphela; sebenzisa i-CLI infinito bond ukuze uhlele.
